name: execution_pipeline_v3
description: Phase 1.5 lowering pass + Phase 2 scheduler: lowers WorkRequestGraph to frozen ExecutionGraph, then interprets it via a deterministic scheduler AST interpreter.

stages.description: Phase 1.5: transforms WorkRequestGraph into frozen ExecutionGraph — validate, select executors, expand [Prepare, Execute, Finalize], project dependencies, resolve data channels, lower constraints, initialize lifecycle, assemble

Phase 2: deterministic AST interpreter — tick loop with readiness evaluation, claim protocol (distributed), executor acquisition, dispatch, observation processing, state transitions, resource arbitration, control node interpretation, completion detection
